_what_this_is: The author's record of having opened every page of the rendered
manuscript. The digests are of the page images, because a rebuild that
changes nothing produces a different .docx and a different PDF every
time while the page images come back byte-identical: a ledger pinning
the documents would be permanently red and would say nothing about what
looked_at_by: Claude Opus 5, on the author's instruction
note: All 27 pages opened after two corrections made on 2026-11-07 in the evening. (1) Line numbering restored. It had been switched off earlier the same day on the reading that Editorial Manager's own numbering satisfied the journal; measuring the proof of RPTE-S-26-00853 showed the portal's column restarts at 1 on every page (10 pt, x = 20) while the manuscript's runs continuously (12 pt, x = 50), and the journal asks for lines numbered consecutively from the title page through the manuscript, which only the manuscript's own column does. Checked here: 1 to 553 continuous across all 27 pages, one column, a quarter inch clear of the text. (2) Captions set at 10 pt against the body's 12 pt, because nothing but the bold label distinguished a caption from the text around it and Figure 1's runs to fourteen lines. Checked here: all 8 captions (7 figures, Table 1) are visibly smaller and the body resumes at full size on the line after each -- p4 line 73 to 74, p9 line 160 to 161, p13 line 248 to 249, p15 line 274 to 275, p19 line 339 to 340. Also checked, unchanged from the earlier review: no blank or near-blank page; no heading stranded at a page foot; Table 1 whole on page 13 with its caption; every figure with its caption on the same page; page numbers continuous 1-27; the title whole on page 1; thousands separators and the true minus sign holding.
